paragraphs.text: Figma-style infinite canvas for DeepSeek Harness with an AI UI design skill, open JSON schema, desig
n audit and image generation.
# Drafi

An AI-native design canvas inside DeepSeek Harness. Design UI mockups in the
right sidebar, send the

current selection into the chat composer with one click,
and let the agent generate or edit the des
ign through an open JSON file.

The package name is `@local/dsh-canvas`; installation paths, `dsh-canvas://` links,
and the `dsh.can
vas@1` document format retain their technical identifiers.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The composer toolbar carries no Drafi button; the right sidebar is the only
entry point. Inserting a
selection still adds a locate chip above the composer.
## What it does

- Infinite canvas with pan/zoom, frames, rectangles, ellipses, lines, text and
image fills; multi-se

lect, move/resize/rotate, layers, properties, smart
snapping, alignment, grouping, copy/paste, z-ord

er and undo/redo.
- Top-level Frame names sit above their frames like Figma labels and are always
vi

sible; clicking a label selects its frame.
- Two drawer buttons fold the side panels: the left one s

its at the top of the
icon rail and folds the layers/components panel away (remembering the last
ope

ned tab), the right one sits at the far right of the tool row and folds the
inspector. Rail buttons

keep working as before.
- Right-click the canvas for a context menu: copy/cut/paste/duplicate/delete

,
insert selection into the chat composer, copy the rendered selection as an
image, export PNG/SVG o

r a Drafi pack, group/ungroup, z-order, lock/unlock,
show/hide, create component, fit, select all.
-

Export opens a dialog with image formats and the portable Drafi pack; rename
and create dialogs are

modal.
- The layer tree starts collapsed; right-click a layer for rename, reveal,
copy/cut/paste/du

plicate/delete, group/ungroup, z-order, lock/hide and
component actions. Row action icons are larger

and appear on hover/selection.
- Auto-layout frames (horizontal/vertical, gap, padding, alignment,

fixed/hug/fill child sizing, nested layouts, text auto-height).
- Components and variants: create a

component from a selection, insert
instances, override text/fills/visibility, swap variants/componen

ts, edit the
main component, detach instances.
- A local style library for fill/text/effect styles,

with live propagation and
detach.
- Multiple fills (solid, linear/radial gradient, image), drop/inne

r shadows,
layer blur and background blur.
- Upload your own fonts (woff2/woff/ttf/otf); they are re

gistered with
`@font-face`, used by the text tool and embedded into exports.
- Non-destructive image

cropping.
- Single-user threaded comments pinned to a node or a page position; the agent
can read a

nd reply through `canvas_comment`.
- SVG and PNG export (selection, frame or the whole page) through

`canvas_comment`.

## Design system and templates

Large-company systems worth knowing: Material Design 3 (Google), Apple Human
Interface Guidelines, F

luent 2 (Microsoft), Carbon (IBM), Spectrum (Adobe),
Lightning (Salesforce), Polaris (Shopify), Prim

er (GitHub), Atlassian Design
System, Base Web (Uber), and Ant Design / Arco / Semi / TDesign in Chi

tlassian Design
System, Base Web (Uber), and Ant Design / Arco / Semi / TDesign in Chinese
products.

**Material Design 3 is the most universal cross-platform default.** For iOS the
platform baseline is

**Apple HIG**. The plugin picks Material 3 when no system
is named, and the iOS templates use HIG m

e HIG**. The plugin picks Material 3 when no system
is named, and the iOS templates use HIG metrics.

- Templates panel (left rail → 模板): insert Settings / Form / List / Detail
pages and the standard st

atus/nav/tab bars.
- Foundation: `canvas_template action="foundation"` returns device (iPhone 16
def

ault / iPhone 15 legacy), Neutral/Minimal/Soft/Compact preset and resolved
tokens.
- Agent: `canvas_

template { action: "list" | "insert", template: "ios-screen" }`.
- Load the system as a Figma-like l

ocal style library: Styles panel → 「内置规范」→
Material 3 / iOS HIG, or `canvas_template { action: "styl

es", system: "material3" | "ios" }`.
The fill/text/effect styles then appear in the Styles panel and

can be applied
to layers; loading does not restyle existing layers automatically.
- Token and templ
ate details: DESIGN.md.
## Figma-style shortcuts

- `V/F/R/O/L/T/H/C/I` — move/frame/rectangle/ellipse/line/text/hand/comment/image
- `Space` drag — p

an; mouse wheel — zoom; `1` fit; `2` fit selection
- `Shift+1` / `Shift+2` / `Shift+0` — fit / fit s

election / 100%
- `⌘/Ctrl+C/X/V/D` — copy/cut/paste/duplicate; `⌘/Ctrl+G` / `⇧⌘G` — group/ungroup
-

`⌘/Ctrl+]` / `[` — forward/backward; `⇧⌘]` / `⇧⌘[` — front/back
- `⌥/Alt` + hover — measure spacing

to adjacent elements; release to clear
- `Shift+A` — add auto layout to selected frame/group
- `⌥⌘K`

/ `Ctrl+Alt+K` — create component from selection
- `⇧⌘L` / `⇧⌘H` — lock/unlock or hide/show selecti

on
- `⌘/Ctrl+Z` / `⇧⌘Z` — undo/redo; `Delete` — delete; arrows — nudge (Shift = 10)
## Limitations (v1)

- No multiplayer collaboration, no realtime cursors, no version history.
- No independent backend or

cloud account; the Host half runs inside the DSH
process and only reads/writes the session workspac

e.
- No server-side rendering, thumbnail generation, font conversion/subsetting or
image processing.

Exports are rendered in the browser, including the PNG that
`canvas_snapshot` returns, which is why

it needs an open canvas tab.
- Background blur is exact on screen but approximated in SVG/PNG expor

t.
- The composer can only receive plain text, so the canvas link is markdown in
the input box; it b

ecomes the clickable reference chip once sent.
- Figma/Penpot file import, full SVG vector editing,

code export and prototyping
are not included. Basic SVG `<path>` import is supported; transforms, te

xt,
filters and masks are skipped with warnings. Image generation requires a
GPT-native image tool o

r a local Codex CLI with `image_generation`; otherwise
import an image.
- The runtime skill is adapt

ed from the user's BD Flutter Dev UI design skill
(see `skills/canvas-ui-design/`); Figma/Flutter-sp

ecific parts were replaced
with canvas tools and design handoff.
- Auto-layout v1 has no wrap, grid,

min/max or absolutely positioned children.
- Instance overrides support text, fills and visibility;

layout overrides on
inner nodes are out of scope.
